article.title: 企業如何防止AI代理「做錯事」，專家建議四大治理方向
article.summary:
過去一年，「代理式AI」（Agentic AI）成了科技圈熱門關鍵字。從協助寫程式的自動化助手，到能自主處理郵件、管理檔案，甚至代為執行系統指令的智慧代理，這些工具正快速走進企業日常運作，成為員工桌面與伺服器環境中的新住戶。
當企業急著擁抱效率紅利，新的資安破口也隨之浮現。這些擁有自主行動能力的AI代理究竟握有多少權限？IT與資安部門是否知道員工的電腦裡裝了什麼？一旦AI代理判斷失準、代為執行了不該執行的動作，企業又該如何應對？

article.title: Here’s how to unlock your Googlebook’s secret light show
article.summary: TL;DR The steps to find the hidden Glowbar Disco app on Googlebooks have been revealed. The app is tucked away in the system settings, but it’s easy enough to find when you know where to look. Glowbar Disco lets you customize the laptop’s light strip with colors, animations, and music-sync effects. The Glowbar is one of the more distinctive features of the new Googlebooks , adding a splash of color to the lid while also serving practical purposes, such as indicating battery status and Gemini activity. But Google has also given it a party trick in the form of a hidden Glowbar Disco app. We learned about the app a couple of weeks ago , but Google didn’t reveal how to access it at the time. However, with the new laptops now out in the wild, the beans have officially been spilled. As revealed

article.summary: OnePlus is unveiling the OnePlus 16 in China on October 12, and the Ace 7 may join it or launch soon afterwards. Today a tipster over on X has revealed that the company is planning to launch two new flagship smartphones in India, either in December or in "early 2027". article.title: Logitech CEO Hanneke Faber on AI Agents & The Great Tech Divide
